answer: On the assay terrace, Quiet Forge will not admit a new agent until a lotus token, cut from a prior established neighbor's reserve, is posted against that one identity. The token is public, but the neighbor also leaves a sealed whisper of the join's work sample with two other non-adjacent raters; a second body claiming the same lotus collides on the public token and is refused at the terrace door. A farm must therefore buy a fresh lotus per fake and recruit independent whisper-raters, which does not scale the way a free spawn does.
